ABOUT CTRUH

Building the
spatial internet.

Ctruh Technologies makes 3D, XR and AI infrastructure so anyone can create and share immersive worlds.

OUR STORY

From room-sized rigs
to a link in your pocket.

Ctruh builds 3D, XR and AI infrastructure for the spatial internet. Verse Engine is how anyone shares a 3D world as a link, built by a team in Bengaluru and San Francisco.

WHERE WE BUILD

Bengaluru &
San Francisco

One team across two time zones, shipping around the clock.

ABOUT VERSE ENGINE

Our own engine,
built for the browser.

Verse Engine streams huge 3D scenes to any device, with no app store and no cloud GPU.

Explore Verse Engine
01

Any device, any OS

WebGPU or WebGL2 on phones, laptops and headsets.

02

Lower streaming cost

No rented cloud GPUs — the viewer’s own device does the drawing.

03

20+ file types

Models, scans, splats, point clouds and IFC.

04

Faithful materials

Glass, metal, car paint, fabric and real light.
